Indian stock markets rebound on falling oil prices and global cues

Indian stock markets, including the Sensex and Nifty, experienced a rebound, reclaiming key levels. This surge was attributed to softening crude oil prices, positive global market sentiment, and foreign fund inflows. Major sectors like oil and gas, banking, and pharmaceuticals saw gains, contributing to the overall market rise.
